title: 2007 AMC 10B Problem 10
statement: Two points \(B\) and \(C\) are in a plane. Let \(S\) be the set of all points \(A\) in the plane for which \(\triangle ABC\) has area \(1.\) Which of the following describes \(S?\)

solutions.text:
Taking \(BC\) as the base, the area is \(\dfrac12(BC)d,\) where \(d\) is the distance from \(A\) to line \(BC.\) The area equals \(1\) exactly when \(d=\dfrac{2}{BC}.\)

The points at this fixed distance from line \(BC\) form two lines parallel to \(BC,\) one on each side.

Thus, the correct answer is A.
hints: Fix \(BC\) as the base; the area determines the height from \(A\)
All points at a fixed distance from line \(BC\) lie on two parallel lines
